name: All Star Bulk Order Block
description: All Star Embroidery bulk ordering, artwork review, and WooCommerce My Account experience.
changelog:
1.3.1

  • Adds explicit artwork-use authorization recorded on WooCommerce orders.
  • Fixes My Account Artwork fallback rendering and duplicate ASBO carts after resubmission.
  • Adds Checkout Block/Store API and HPOS compatibility.
  • Uses fresh nonces for cached pages and moves large frontend/account CSS and JS to cacheable assets.
  • Improves update, category, pricing, and catalog-repair performance while preserving ASBO pricing and Supplier Sync boundaries.
